# GitHub Copilot Repository Instructions

Follow these rules for this repository:

- Prefer project conventions already present in the codebase.
- Do not introduce new dependencies without explaining why.
- Do not expose secrets or credentials.
- Do not modify unrelated files.
- When generating code, include test considerations.
- When fixing bugs, explain root cause and regression risk.
- Use existing architecture boundaries.
- Keep changes small and reviewable.
